text: dsh-wander-chat 是一个 DSH 网页端插件，在侧边栏增加「新建漫游会话」入口。点击后，客户端请求插件的 Host 路由，按配置创建或复用固定工作目录并注册 Workspace，再在该工作区启动新会话，因此无需先选择本地目录。所有漫游会话共享工作目录和侧边栏分组，单个会话仍由 DSH 创建。插件还提供目录与分组名称配置，并在创建失败时显示原因和重试入口。适合希望快速开启会话并将其集中到同一工作区的 DSH 用户。使用时无需 API 密钥或外部账号。

dsh-wander-chat adds a DSH web sidebar entry to start sessions without choosing a folder. It creates or reuses the configured directory, registers its Workspace, then starts the session there. The directory and group label are configurable. On failure, the panel shows an error and retry option.
想在侧边栏点一下就开一个不用选目录的新会话。
能把临时会话都放进同一个工作区分组吗？
希望自定义漫游会话的工作目录和侧边栏名称。
dsh-wander-chat 的功能「一键新建漫游会话」：侧边栏入口打开后自动确保固定工作目录和 Workspace 已注册，并在其中启动新会话；不需要先选择本地目录。创建失败时页面展示错误并可重试。

[English](README.en.md) | 中文

DSH 插件：在侧边栏「新会话」按钮**正下方**新增一行「新建漫游会话」，一键在**不选择本地目录**的情况下开启会话。

所有漫游会话统一归入一个固定的工作区分组（默认显示名「漫游会话」，目录 `~/.dsh/wander-chat`），目录与分组名都可以在设置里改。

dsh-wander-chat README · 效果：- 侧边栏「新会话」下方多出一行「新建漫游会话」
- 点击后直接创建会话并跳转，**不弹目录选择器**
- 所有漫游会话在侧边栏归入同一个分组，而不是散成多个工作区
- 每个会话的内容仍然各自独立存放在 DSH 官方的 `~/.dsh/sessions/--<目录编码>--/session-<uuid>/` 下

dsh-wander-chat README · 安装：```bash
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop

dsh-wander-chat README · "dsh-wander-chat"：pnpm install
```

然后重启 DSH 或重载 profile。

dsh-wander-chat README · 配置：**设置 → 插件 → 漫游会话**

配置表单**直接渲染在这个插件详情页里**（描述下方、插件行上方），点进插件就能看到，不需要再找入口。

| 字段 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `root` | `~/.dsh/wander-chat` | 漫游会话共用的工作目录，支持 `~` 前缀，不存在时自动创建 |
| `title` | `漫游会话` | 该目录在侧边栏显示的分组名称 |

也可以直接写在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里：

```yaml
- id: dsh-wander-chat
  config:
    root: '~/.dsh/wander-chat'
    title: '漫游会话'

dsh-wander-chat README · 关于配置页的实现：DSH 的 `settings` 服务虽然会给带 Config schema 的插件发布 `autoGenerate` 标志，但**不会自动生成 UI** —— 配置页必须由客户端半边自己注册。本插件的做法是：

1. Host 半边声明 Schemastery `Config`（字段与描述即上面的表格）
2. Client 半边注册 `plugins.bundle.config`（key 为包名 `dsh-wander-chat`），表单就出现在插件详情页里
3. 表单用 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives` 的 `SettingsFormModel` / `SettingsForm` / `SettingsValueField`，通过 `ctx.configForms` 读写 Host 配置

只有点「保存」才会写入；离开页面会丢弃未保存的修改。

只注册这一个插槽是刻意的：`plugins.row.config` 会让插件行再多出一个 `›` 配置入口，而详情页已经直接展示同一个表单，重复入口只会让人犹豫该点哪个。

dsh-wander-chat README · 工作原理：```
点击「新建漫游会话」
  → main 面板 wander-chat 挂载
  → GET /dsh-wander-chat            Host：mkdir -p + workspaceRegistry.create(path, title)
  → ctx.workspaces.create({ path }) 客户端：幂等，把工作区同步进本地投影

`startSession(workspaceId)` 就是侧边栏「新会话」按钮自己调用的那个 API，只是显式传入了工作区，所以不会弹出目录选择器。

**侵入面**：一个目录 + 一条 Workspace 注册 + 一条只读路由。不碰会话存储、会话格式、Agent 循环或工作区归属规则。

dsh-wander-chat README · 为什么每会话不单独用一个目录当 cwd：DSH 要求会话的 `cwd` 与工作区路径**严格相等**（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-workspace` 的 `attachSession` 会校验，启动时还会按 cwd 对账补建工作区）。如果让每个会话的 cwd 是 `wander-chat/<uuid>`，DSH 会为每个 UUID 各建一个独立工作区，侧边栏反而散成 N 个分组。

而「每会话独立目录」这个需求，DSH 在存储层已经原生实现 —— 见上文 `~/.dsh/sessions/` 的结构。所以插件只需要一个固定工作区，其余交给 DSH。
section: 为什么每会话不单独用一个目录当 cwd

text:
dsh-wander-chat README · 注意：`link:` 方式安装的插件位于 profile 之外，Node 会按软链接的真实路径解析依赖，因此**无法**引用 profile 里的 `@deepseek-ai/*` 包。本插件为此：

- `~` 展开自行实现（只用 `node:os`），不依赖 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-home-paths`
- 只在 Host 半边依赖 `@deepseek-ai/schemastery`（用于 Config schema），并把它作为本地依赖安装

dsh-wander-chat README · 开发：无构建步骤：`client.js` 是手写的浏览器 bundle，只注册一个惰性工厂。

客户端改动需要重建 Web 产物后刷新页面；只有 `pnpm run dev:web` 在跑时才能免刷新热更。

```bash
npm test    # Host 半边测试（18 项，跑在临时目录里，不碰你的 home）
```

设计取舍与调研依据（含被否决的方案和 DSH 内部约束的源码定位）记录在 [DESIGN.md](DESIGN.md)。

[中文](README.md) | English

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) plugin that adds a
**New roaming session** row to the sidebar, directly under **New Session**. One click starts a
Session **without picking a local folder**.

Every roaming Session is grouped under one fixed Workspace (labelled **漫游会话** by default,
directory `~/.dsh/wander-chat`). Both the directory and the group label are configurable.

dsh-wander-chat README · What it does：- A **New roaming session** row in the sidebar, right below New Session
- One click creates the Session and navigates to it — **no directory picker**
- All roaming Sessions land in the same sidebar group instead of scattering into many Workspaces
- Each Session's own content still lives in DSH's official per-Session directory,
  `~/.dsh/sessions/--<encoded-directory>--/session-<uuid>/`

dsh-wander-chat README · Install：```bash
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop

dsh-wander-chat README · "dsh-wander-chat"：pnpm install
```

Then restart DSH or reload the profile.

dsh-wander-chat README · Configuration：**Settings → Plugins → 漫游会话**

The form renders **directly on the plugin's own page** (below its description, above its rows),
so opening the plugin is all it takes — there is no separate entry to discover.

| Field | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `root` | `~/.dsh/wander-chat` | The working directory every roaming Session shares. A leading `~` is expanded; the directory is created on demand. |
| `title` | `漫游会话` | The name this directory shows as in the sidebar session list. |

dsh-wander-chat README · Configuration：You can also set them in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: dsh-wander-chat
  config:
    root: '~/.dsh/wander-chat'
    title: '漫游会话'

dsh-wander-chat README · How the settings page is wired：DSH's `settings` service publishes an `autoGenerate` flag for any plugin carrying a Config
schema, but it does **not** generate UI from it — the page has to be contributed by the client
half. This plugin:
section: How the settings page is wired

text:
dsh-wander-chat README · How the settings page is wired：1. Declares a Schemastery `Config` on the Host half (the fields above).
2. Registers `plugins.bundle.config` (keyed by the package name `dsh-wander-chat`) from the
   client half, which places the form on the plugin's own page.
3. Builds the form from `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives`
   (`SettingsFormModel` / `SettingsForm` / `SettingsValueField`), reading and writing the Host
   configuration through `ctx.configForms`.

Only **Save** writes; leaving the page discards unsaved edits.
section: How the settings page is wired

text:
dsh-wander-chat README · How the settings page is wired：Registering that one slot is deliberate: `plugins.row.config` would add a second `›` configure
entry on the plugin row, and since the page already shows the same form, a duplicate entry only
makes people wonder which one to click.
section: How the settings page is wired

text:
dsh-wander-chat README · How it works：```
click "New roaming session"
  → the main panel for key `wander-chat` mounts
  → GET /dsh-wander-chat             Host: mkdir -p + workspaceRegistry.create(path, title)
  → ctx.workspaces.create({ path })  Client: idempotent, syncs the Workspace into its projection

`startSession(workspaceId)` is the very call the shipped New Session button makes — with no
argument. Passing the Workspace explicitly is what removes the directory picker.

dsh-wander-chat README · How it works：**Footprint**: one directory, one Workspace registration, one read-only route. It touches no
Session storage, no Session format, no Agent loop, and none of the Workspace membership rules.

dsh-wander-chat README · Why each Session does not get its own cwd directory：DSH requires a Session's `cwd` to be **exactly equal** to the Workspace path
(`@deepseek-ai/dsh-workspace`'s `attachSession` validates it, and startup reconciles stored
Sessions by cwd, creating a Workspace per distinct cwd). Making each Session's cwd
`wander-chat/<uuid>` would therefore give DSH one Workspace per UUID — the sidebar would
scatter into N groups, the opposite of the goal.
section: Why each Session does not get its own cwd directory

text:
dsh-wander-chat README · Why each Session does not get its own cwd directory：The underlying need — a directory per Session — is already provided natively by DSH's storage
layer, as the `~/.dsh/sessions/` layout above shows. So the plugin needs exactly one fixed
Workspace and lets DSH do the rest.
section: Why each Session does not get its own cwd directory

text:
dsh-wander-chat README · Caveat：A `link:`-installed plugin lives outside the profile, and Node resolves its imports from the
symlink's real path, so it **cannot** reach the profile's `@deepseek-ai/*` packages. This plugin
works around that by:

- expanding `~` itself (with `node:os` only), instead of depending on `@deepseek-ai/dsh-home-paths`
- depending on `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` (needed for the Config schema) **only** on the Host
  half, installed as a local dependency

dsh-wander-chat README · Development：No build step: `client.js` is a hand-written browser bundle that registers one lazy factory.

Client-side changes need the Web artifacts rebuilt and the page refreshed; they hot-reload
without a refresh only while `pnpm run dev:web` is running.

```bash
npm test    # host-half checks (18 of them, all under a temp directory — your home is untouched)
```

dsh-wander-chat README · Development：The design rationale and the research behind it — including the approaches that were ruled out
and the exact DSH source locations of the constraints — are recorded in
[DESIGN.md](DESIGN.md) (Chinese).
